# awdit

> An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.

An audit log you can silently delete from is decoration. Most are. The property that matters is not "it records" but "a missing record is visible".

## Install

```
pip install awdit
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Write one sensitive action to it and then try to remove the record.

## Composes with

- [awbac](https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/) — Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.
- [awseal](https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/) — Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awdit.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
